answer: To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 12 epochs old, anchored at a ledge checkpoint. The oasis chain is verified at intake and ripple publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 12 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. The attacker spends 72 dollars and 19 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
